messages:
elaine: Quick async check — GA gating for the pricing/packaging rollout: we need metering adapter + quota enforcement + contract template signoff by EOD Wed. Who's owning final integration?

sam: I can take the metering adapter integration (PR in draft). Need final schema from billing for plan tiers.

miran: Sending current ratecard schema in a sec. Note: tier 'enterprise-plus' has proration edge we didn't include earlier.

miran: https://internal.redwood/ratecard/schema-v2

ojas: FYI metering adapter needs 2 fields: `plan_id` and `commitment_window`. If proration exists we need a boolean flag `prorated`. I'll update the adapter after schema confirm.

elaine: @sam @miran @ojas can we get a brief ownership table? I started one: 1) Metering adapter PR - sam 2) Quota enforcement hook - ??? 3) Contract templates - kira 4) Billing migration - miran 5) Rollout canary - infra

sam: I can add quota enforcement hook but need product acceptance criteria. Is it just hard fail on limit, or soft-limit alerts + throttle?

elaine: For GA we need hard enforcement for reserved plans, soft alerts for trial/free. I'll add examples.

kira: Legal signoff on contract templates is blocked by one clause: "usage overages" needs explicit language tied to metering units. Sending redline now.

miran: I'll adjust ratecard to include unit labels so legal text can reference them.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2027-06-22T15:00Z for pricing-packaging-v2 on staging.

ojas: Sam — once you post PR ping me, I'll run end-to-end smoke with a simulated overage case.

sam: Will do. Targeting PR ready tomorrow AM.

elaine: Great — action items: sam (metering + quota PR), miran (ratecard proration fix), kira (legal redline), ojas (smoke test). I'll update the rollout doc and ping infra for canary slots.

sam: small question — do we need migration script for existing quota rows? If yes I can add to PR.

miran: Yes, migration needed for committed contracts. I'll provide mapping.

elaine: Thanks all. If you're blocked reply with @elaine. Otherwise I'll close this thread Friday with final owners. :v:
